Uniform coherent input is in ran D*, so absorbs completely. Checked 443 actual finite tests; no numerical test is claimed as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The object is fixed-excitation hard-core quantum hopping on an all-to-all spin network, with a natural experimentally motivated monitored-coordinate family. The result exactly classifies whether irreversible loss is certain for all initial states, finds a sharp nonclassical monitored-coordinate threshold, and gives robust closed probabilities for each localized state and a coherent exception.
